💡 Key Empirical Insights: Train Flipped vs. Test Flipped

1. Train Flipped Mechanism

In Train (74 frames), inverted frames come from Patient 12 (tumor margin retraction), Patient 20 (lateral traction), and Patient 53 (grasper flap lift). The liver ridge is pulled into the top $10\%$ of the screen ($Y \le 0.01$).

2. Test Flipped Mechanism

In Test (31 frames), Patient 41 exhibits extreme visceral retraction where the camera is positioned close to the diaphragm. The ridge is hoisted to $Y = 0.007$, visually mirroring the inverted morphology of Patient 12 and Patient 40!

3. The Geometric Resolution

Because the 2D pixel coordinates invert identically in both Train and Test, the 4 invariant biological junctions ($J_{top}, J_{bottom}$) provide the exact coordinate anchor needed for the model to generalize across both splits!
